cards.title: An orchestrator per service
cards.text: Watches one service's errors, decides what each needs, and decides when to ship.

cards.title: Expected
cards.text: The runbook lists it, so it is acknowledged and nothing runs.

cards.title: A code fix
cards.text: A session on LouisAgent.Api: it fixes, tests and hands back a branch.

cards.title: Escalate
cards.text: A person on the runbook's team takes it.

cards.title: Checked, not trusted
cards.text: The commit, a replay and the tests; a person merges, and nothing deploys on its own.
